annotations.title: Which company numbers or facility IDs have emissions rows

description: For up to 100 company numbers or facility IDs of one id_type, whether rows are held and how many, by source, layer and years, counting only rows the key's licence includes. It counts rows, never an emissions figure, and not held says nothing about a company's emissions. Inputs: id_type, ids, source (required with id_type facility), compact (true leaves out entitlement). Available only with an API key whose licence includes Emissions Data; any other call returns a short notice.

compact.description: true leaves out schema and entitlement and gives each row's attribution notice by reference; default false

id_type.description: What the ids are: siren, siret, tw_stock_code, nif, abn, au_id_as_filed, ca_bn, qc_sago, ico, rut, il_corp, us_ticker, facility

name: match_emissions_ids
